mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, u.nick_name AS author_nick_name, u.icon AS author_icon, c.application_id, a.name AS application_name, c.kind, c.title, c.content, c.state, c.like_count, c.published_at, c.created_at FROM creation c JOIN creator_user u ON u.id = c.user_id JOIN ai_application a ON a.id = c.application_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM creation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE creation SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE creation SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND like_count > 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM creation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creation WHERE state = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creation WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND state = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creation WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND state = 'PUBLISHED'
